status: REGISTERED before labeling; construction and held-out sessions are declared here, not chosen after results
question: How accurate and how available are the result-distance, gameplay-progress, coin-counter, fuel-gauge and terminal-cause readers on independent real frames from separate sessions?

readers.result_distance: artifacts/runs/66ce7f08-ef45-466c-ac77-33bacd0f0a41/result-reader.json (frozen Cycle 1 terminal bank) and any Cycle 2 successor bank built only from construction sessions
readers.coin_counter: hud-coin-counter-2.0 (gameplay bank over the declared coin region)
readers.terminal_cause: recognized result variant (driver_down_native / out_of_fuel_discovery) as evidence

labeling.method: manual, from enlarged crops of the sealed frames, recorded before the reader output for that frame is viewed; frames whose reader output was already inspected during development are construction frames by definition
labeling.fuel_bins: empty, low (<0.25), mid (0.25-0.75), high (>0.75) judged visually; the reader's fraction must fall in the labeled bin
labeling.storage: artifacts/hud-independent-labels/cycle-2-reader-labels.json with source run id, frame path and sha256 per label

splits.heldout: every native session sealed after this registration whose frames were not viewed with reader output before labeling; the native reliability study sessions are the first held-out set
splits.rule: no frame, session or glyph moves from held-out to construction after evaluation; a bank extension makes its source sessions construction for every later evaluation

metrics: availability: valid readings / labeled frames per reader
exact accuracy: exact matches / valid readings (result and progress metres, coins)
wrong-accept rate: valid readings that disagree with the label / valid readings
fuel: fraction of valid readings inside the labeled bin
terminal cause: agreement of the recognized variant with the labeled cause; unknown counted separately
per-digit confusion for rejected result readings (e.g. 6 versus 9 ambiguity observed in session b8e15581)
acceptance_for_objective_use: a reader may feed an objective only if its wrong-accept rate on held-out frames is zero over at least 20 labeled frames from at least three sessions and its availability is reported alongside
known_construction_facts: session b8e15581 attempt 0: true result 246 m; frozen terminal bank rejected the third digit as 6/9 ambiguous (0.891 vs 0.896), a correct fail-closed refusal
session fa103b59 attempt 0: HUD maximum 398 m; terminal reading outcome recorded in the run and diagnosed during development
